name: io.github.TMHSDigital/tailscale-mcp
title: Tailscale MCP
description: Let AI agents see and use your tailnet: status, SSH config, Serve/Funnel sharing, ping matrix

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_MCP_ALLOW_FUNNEL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let share_port expose a port to the open internet with Funnel (off by default)

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for monitoring only: no share tools, and no SSH config writes

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_MCP_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to the tailscale binary if it is not on PATH or in the default install location

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-call timeout for tailscale commands in milliseconds (default 10000)
